name: Harry Potter
overview: Scripture clearly warns believers against engaging with witchcraft, sorcery, and familiar spirits, emphasizing that such practices defile and separate one from God (Leviticus 19:31). The Bible identifies sorcery as a sin linked with idolatry and rebellion, warning that those who persist in these practices without repentance face eternal judgment (Galatians 5:20; Revelation 9:21; Revelation 21:8; Revelation 22:15). Instead, Christians are called to resist conformity to worldly influences and be transformed through the renewal of their minds to discern and follow God's perfect will (Romans 12:2).
